note: quince#58, Operator ruling 2026-07-27: `tick-overdue` already names an interval the watch could not see, and the missing half was that the catch-up tick's FINDINGS must not read as a complete account of it. A tick diffs the CURRENT queue against the STORED observation, so a PR that opened AND closed inside the gap leaves no trace at all — 'no events' is a claim about the endpoints presented as a claim about the interval. Not wrong; UNFALSIFIABLE. Here the watch was due at 05:01:00Z and it is now 06:00:00Z, so the interval from the last tick at 05:00:00Z is 3600s wide and nothing observed it. THE QUEUE IS EMPTY AND THAT IS THE POINT: this state has no PRs, so a state diff has nothing to report, and without the `unreconciled` line the whole report would be `tick-overdue` plus silence — which is exactly the shape the retiring architect read as 'nothing was missed', four times, and could not have justified. THE RULING DELIBERATELY DOES NOT REQUIRE FINDING the vanished PR: reconciliation against the events API was ruled out, because its retention fails in exactly the long-gap case this worries about most. The tool is required to stop claiming there was nothing to find. `unreconciled` does NOT wake — it rides beside `tick-overdue`, which already does, and the pair is one fact.
